title: Electricity balance (MWh), by production and consumption, contents and month

snapshot.retrieval_note: Retrieved by the NGDP ingestion pipeline from the official PxWebApi v2 endpoint.

transformations: Reshape monthly columns from wide to long format.
Exclude cells marked as unavailable with two dots.
Normalize monthly periods to timestamps at runtime.
Remove numeric hierarchy prefixes from source labels at runtime.
limitations: The dashboard reads a validated local snapshot instead of querying the API on every page load.
The snapshot contains four generation series, not the complete electricity balance table.
Series begin in different months because unavailable source values are excluded.
Statistics Norway may revise historical figures in future releases.
